subject: general
question: The Gua mines of Jharkhand is associated with which of the following minerals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron-ore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Gua mines** in Jharkhand are primarily known for their **Iron-ore** deposits.
 
• Iron-ore is a critical raw material for the production of steel and is one of the most abundant minerals found in the region.</li&
